scope: T2 passive dev2 child lifecycle and explicit parent-publication correction. Source reads plus owned design/report only; no implementation, tests of an implementation, SDK build, source-tree changes, host edits, SSH, hardware, or goal API.

requested_resolution.parent_staging: Required on T2 only: both devices set and verify RegisterService=kOSBooleanFalse before their respective IOHIDDevice::start. Never rely on the old published-parent rollback.
requested_resolution.precommit_failure: Timer-arm or earlier failure registers neither device; withdraw the unpublished child, balance successful base starts exactly once, then dispose the private transport. Base-start self-stop is not duplicated. No matched keyboard clients exist on this corrected failure path.
requested_resolution.commit: Arm under the shared gate, acquire explicit permanent parent/child retains, then commit. Outside the gate request parent then child asynchronous registration. No false-return or rollback is permitted after commit. A concurrent runtime stop may suppress an as-yet-unissued registration; an already issued request is handled with retained state and stopped admission guards.
requested_resolution.postcommit_retention: Both committed stop wrappers inhibit delivery and defer superclass destruction unconditionally, including at zero dispatch count. No shared-loop disposal or permanent-pin release. Precommit-only handleStop/dispose/free guards prevent bypass; reaching committed free via balanced releases is forbidden and must be tested, not repaired by resurrection.

state_property.layout: Eight LE32 fields: version, byte_size, committed, route_ready, faulted, stop_requested, signed last_error, reserved.
state_property.scope: One copied observation. Non-atomic across copies, registry/descriptor/endpoint reads, callbacks and subsequent startup. Not future liveness or physical-input proof.
state_property.failure_rule: Fault/stop disables routing and removes old ready properties before replacement. Failed replacement leaves absence; original T2 error and publication error remain distinct. A reader may already hold the previous immutable copy.

source_findings.finding: Frozen T1 calls base start before timer arm. Base may register the keyboard before returning. startCandidate false cleanup only detaches; it is not a proof that matched keyboard clients are gone.
source_findings.classification: SOURCE_CORRECTNESS_GAP; not a claimed observed T1 runtime fault

source_findings.finding: RegisterService=false suppresses base registration; own first-match notification later creates interfaces. Explicit IOService::registerService does not consult that property, so the design intentionally leaves it false after commit.

ReportDescriptor is the real base-published descriptor OSData. Property-bytes returns OSNumber.numberOfBytes bytes of unsigned64BitValue; a width32 value2 is four native LE bytes here. The RPC cannot distinguish a four-byte OSData from the same OSNumber representation; source binding establishes type.

Guarding only handleStop is too late: base stop removes notifier/event-source state. Existing parent free/dispose are unconditional and need T2 destruction barriers. OSObject reaches a freeing sentinel before virtual free, so a free-time retain is not a legitimate lifetime mechanism.
The property getter retains/copies one property object; separate reads are not one coherent transaction. Mutable in-place OSData updates and stale ready fallback are excluded by the design.

review_reconciliation.l1: Addressed with T2-only parent staging. Frozen T1/keyboard builds are not modified.
review_reconciliation.l2: Settled exact interface key/type, real ReportDescriptor read, and separate state record. Root owns registry-gate code and its final schema tests.
review_reconciliation.l3: Explicit permanent parent and child pins plus stricter unconditional postcommit retention. No superclass stop after commit, even if current dispatch count is zero. This stricter detail requires review; it is not claimed already approved by the draft001 review.
differences_requiring_final_review: RegisterService=false stays installed; explicit asynchronous registerService is the only publication path. Source supports this without removing the property.

Unexpected runtime stop before a request can skip registration; normal committed successful paths request parent once before child. A late async match is permitted only against retained, stopped state.
Committed child base stop is deferred too, rather than authorizing destruction from a sampled zero dispatch count.

Committed diagnostic installation failure is a runtime fault retaining the cohort, never a false parent-start return. Storage is prepared before commit; a committed1 record is not published before actual commit.

planned_tests_not_run: Execute future real start/stop bodies with failures at parent/child property installation, allocation, attach, base start, descriptor, gated verify and timer arm; zero registrations on every false-return path.
Model actual base self-stop; balanced private rollback, no duplicate stop, detach or release.
Direct precommit registry opens refuse; atomic admission phase does not invert arbitration and workloop locks.
Immediate/reentrant first-match, stop between requests, child stop during dispatch and concurrent parent stop preserve lifetime; normal committed order is parent before child.
Zero-dispatch committed stop still cannot call base stop/dispose; permanent pins survive ordinary framework/attachment/dispatch releases; committed free remains unreachable.
Exact dev2 ID/length routing, immutable copied report lifetime and unchanged 2038-byte receive bounds; no feature/output/request path.
Exact four-byte interface and110-byte descriptor reads; malformed/missing/MIG errors fail. State flags/size/version and diagnostic allocation/update failures cannot admit a retired child.
unchanged_scope: Frozen T1 producer and core002, SPI power/PIO/protocol, five request keys, 556-byte enumeration record, prior captures/KCs and existing host.
No Feature/Output/mode/dimensions/haptic operation; descriptor gate remains closed.
Root-owned HOST_CONTRACT.md and REGISTRY_GATE_DESIGN.md were read, not edited. Their recorded hashes are observed concurrent snapshots, not an Astra freeze.
